content_sections.heading: KSRLPS Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: KSRLPS has announced a total of 34 vacancies across different posts and locations. The vacancy distribution includes Haveri and Udupi district openings.

content_sections.text: Minimum Age Limit: 18 Years Maximum Age limit: 45 Years Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for KSRLPS Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official KSRLPS recruitment portal. Open the available jobs section. Select the required post. Check eligibility criteria and job details. Complete the online application form. Upload required information/documents. Submit the application before the last date. Save the application confirmation for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in KSRLPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 34 vacancies are available under KSRLPS Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in KSRLPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes District Manager, Taluk Program Manager, Block Manager, Cluster Supervisor, MIS Assistant, DEO and Office Assistant posts.

faq.question: Q3. How to apply for KSRLPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official KSRLPS recruitment portal at jobsksrlps.karnataka.gov.in.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the job location for KSRLPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The vacancies are available in Haveri and Udupi districts of Karnataka.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for KSRLPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for most vacancies is 11 September 2026.
